decisions.reason: A core upholstery fabric with its own web page signals satisfactory early performance in line with aspirations, and interior textile collections usually run several seasons.
It is only mentioned on the website, so its results are less certain, but it sits close to the established offer and industry growth gives enough slack to keep it in the collection for now.
A flame-retardant curtain fabric with its own page serves contract and hospitality demand, likely meets aspirations, and fits the firm's functional-fabric strategy.
A wool-blend decoration fabric fits the shift toward renewable materials, and one year is too short a period to judge a collection item against aspirations.
Its modest web presence suggests uncertain results, but the wool fabric supports the sustainability direction and growing industry turnover lets the firm carry it a while longer.
